1.sahih_international: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
1.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
1.yusuf_ali: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
1.shakir: Has not there come to you the news of the overwhelming calamity?
1.muhammad_sarwar: Have you heard the story of the overwhelming event (the Day of Judgment)?
1.mohsin_khan: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);
1.arberry: Hast thou received the story of the Enveloper?

2.sahih_international: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
2.pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
2.yusuf_ali: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
2.shakir: (Some) faces on that day shall be downcast,
2.muhammad_sarwar: On that day the faces of some people will be humbly cast down,
2.mohsin_khan: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians, etc.).

3.muhammad_sarwar: troubled and tired as a result of their deeds in the past.
3.mohsin_khan: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allah), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace).

4.sahih_international: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
4.yusuf_ali: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
4.muhammad_sarwar: They will suffer the heat of the blazing fire
4.mohsin_khan: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire,

5.sahih_international: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
5.yusuf_ali: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
5.shakir: Made to drink from a boiling spring.
5.muhammad_sarwar: and will be made to drink from a fiercely boiling spring.
5.mohsin_khan: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,

6.sahih_international: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
6.pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
6.yusuf_ali: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
6.shakir: They shall have no food but of thorns,
6.muhammad_sarwar: They will have no food other than bitter and thorny fruit
6.mohsin_khan: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,
6.arberry: no food for them but cactus thorn

7.sahih_international: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
7.pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
7.yusuf_ali: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
7.shakir: Which will neither fatten nor avail against hunger.
7.muhammad_sarwar: which will neither fatten them nor satisfy them.
7.mohsin_khan: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

8.sahih_international: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
8.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
8.yusuf_ali: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
8.shakir: (Other) faces on that day shall be happy,
8.muhammad_sarwar: However, on that day the faces of other people will be happy.
8.mohsin_khan: (Other) faces, that Day, will be joyful,

9.muhammad_sarwar: and pleased with the result of their deeds in the past.
9.mohsin_khan: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism).

10.muhammad_sarwar: They will live in an exalted garden

11.sahih_international: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
11.pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,
11.yusuf_ali: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
11.shakir: Wherein you shall not hear vain talk.
11.muhammad_sarwar: wherein they will not hear any vain talk.
11.mohsin_khan: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood,

12.sahih_international: Within it is a flowing spring.
12.yusuf_ali: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
12.muhammad_sarwar: Therein will be a flowing spring,
12.mohsin_khan: Therein will be a running spring,

13.sahih_international: Within it are couches raised high
13.yusuf_ali: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
13.mohsin_khan: Therein will be thrones raised high,

15.shakir: And cushions set in a row,

17.sahih_international: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
17.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
17.yusuf_ali: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
17.shakir: Will they not then consider the camels, how they are created?
17.muhammad_sarwar: Have they not looked at how the camel is created,
17.mohsin_khan: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?
17.arberry: What, do they not consider how the camel was created,

18.sahih_international: And at the sky - how it is raised?
18.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?
18.yusuf_ali: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
18.shakir: And the heaven, how it is reared aloft,
18.muhammad_sarwar: how the heavens are raised up high,
18.mohsin_khan: And at the heaven, how it is raised?

19.sahih_international: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
19.pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up?
19.yusuf_ali: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
19.shakir: And the mountains, how they are firmly fixed,
19.muhammad_sarwar: how the mountains are set firm,
19.mohsin_khan: And at the mountains, how they are rooted and fixed firm?

20.sahih_international: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
20.pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread?
20.yusuf_ali: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
20.shakir: And the earth, how it is made a vast expanse?
20.muhammad_sarwar: and how the earth is spread out?
20.mohsin_khan: And at the earth, how it is spread out?

21.sahih_international: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
21.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
21.yusuf_ali: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
21.shakir: Therefore do remind, for you are only a reminder.
21.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), preach; you are only a preacher.
21.mohsin_khan: So remind them (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)), you are only a one who reminds.
21.arberry: Then remind them! Thou art only a reminder;

22.sahih_international: You are not over them a controller.
22.pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
22.yusuf_ali: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
22.shakir: You are not a watcher over them;
22.muhammad_sarwar: You do not have full control over them.
22.mohsin_khan: You are not a dictator over them.
22.arberry: thou art not charged to oversee them.

23.sahih_international: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
23.pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
23.yusuf_ali: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
23.shakir: But whoever turns back and disbelieves,
23.muhammad_sarwar: However, those who turn away and disbelieve,
23.mohsin_khan: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves
23.arberry: But he who turns his back, and disbelieves,

24.sahih_international: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
24.pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
24.yusuf_ali: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
24.shakir: Allah will chastise him with the greatest chastisement.
24.muhammad_sarwar: God will punish them with the greatest torment.
24.mohsin_khan: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
24.arberry: God shall chastise him with the greatest chastisement.

25.sahih_international: Indeed, to Us is their return.
25.pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
25.yusuf_ali: For to Us will be their return;
25.shakir: Surely to Us is their turning back,
25.muhammad_sarwar: To Us they will all return.
25.mohsin_khan: Verily, to Us will be their return;
25.arberry: Truly, to Us is their return;

26.sahih_international: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
26.yusuf_ali: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
26.shakir: Then surely upon Us is the taking of their account.
26.muhammad_sarwar: In Our hands are their accounts.
26.mohsin_khan: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.
26.arberry: then upon Us shall rest their reckoning.
